# Ed25519 edge vectors (#3357): name, public key A, message, signature R||S, and the verdict
# of the cofactorless RFC 8032 check that Go's crypto/ed25519 and ed25519-dalek's verify make
# (KD-d). broker/test/keydiff and keycheck's own tests both check every line, so a crypto bump
# on either side that changes one of these verdicts fails CI. All hex; the message is "msg".
#  valid                   an honest signature
#  s_plus_L, s_high_bit    a non-canonical S: refused (no malleability)
#  torsionN_A[_idR]        A is the small-order point N of the 8-torsion, S is zero, and R is
#                          -[k]A (k hashed with R as the identity) or the identity itself;
#                          the cofactorless check accepts some and refuses others
#  identity_A_zero_sig     A and R the identity, S zero: accepted
#  noncanon_A_identity     A encodes the identity as y = p+1: accepted (the key is not refused)
#  identity_negzero_A      A is the identity with the x sign bit set: accepted
#  noncanon_R              A the identity, R encodes it as y = p+1, S zero: refused
#  R_plus_T8               an honest signature with an 8-torsion point added to R: refused
#  mixed_A_cofactored_only a mixed-order A whose signature only a cofactored check admits: refused
